mechanics.title: Config options
mechanics.description: showLocation (default true) includes the villager's location; mentionModdedVillagers (default true) also announces deaths of modded villager entities.

editor_notes: Requires Collective. Pack ships no config for it, so defaults apply.
name: Villager Death Messages
summary: Broadcasts a chat message whenever a villager dies, showing its custom name (if any), profession, cause of death and last location.
